title: advanCARE
summary: Community healthcare platform for Cagayan: families request caregivers, transport, telehealth and prescriptions in a PWA, while municipality-scoped staff dispatch and audit them in an admin console.

nodes.label: Family / client
nodes.detail: Household member or sponsor who subscribes, requests care and tracks it in the app.

nodes.label: Caregiver
nodes.detail: Accredited caregiver who sees assigned shifts and clocks in and out.

nodes.label: Staff / Admin
nodes.detail: Municipality-scoped admin or SUPER_ADMIN who runs requests and accounts in the console.

nodes.label: Website visitor
nodes.detail: Public reader learning about plans, services and donations.

nodes.label: Marketing website
nodes.detail: Vite site with home, about, services, plans, program, donate and contact pages.

nodes.label: Welcome & sign-in
nodes.detail: Welcome, onboarding, register and email-code sign-in screens of the app.

nodes.label: Home & services
nodes.detail: App home and service menu behind the auth guard (HashRouter PWA).

nodes.label: Request flows
nodes.detail: Telehealth, triage, prescription, transport, supplies and caregiver request screens.

nodes.label: Requests & reports
nodes.detail: Request list/detail, records, trends and dashboard screens.

nodes.label: Care Assistant
nodes.detail: Chat screen that asks the Gemini-backed assistant for guidance.

nodes.label: Caregiver mode
nodes.detail: Caregiver home and shift screen with clock in/out.

nodes.label: App state
nodes.detail: Session, profile, requests, drafts and offline queue persisted in localStorage.

nodes.label: API client
nodes.detail: The app's only network boundary; bearer-token fetches to /api/v1.

nodes.label: Catalog & rules
nodes.detail: Approved plans, prices and service dependency rules, plus demo fixtures.

nodes.label: Capacitor shells
nodes.detail: iOS and Android wrappers of the same PWA bundle.

nodes.label: Admin login & MFA
nodes.detail: Staff sign-in with password, TOTP code and MFA enrolment, plus invite acceptance.

nodes.label: Admin dashboards
nodes.detail: Overview, requests, shifts, clients, caregivers, drivers, telehealth, payments and reports pages.

nodes.label: Admin accounts
nodes.detail: SUPER_ADMIN pages for staff accounts, invitations, MFA reset and audit log.

nodes.label: Pages API proxy
nodes.detail: Cloudflare Pages worker that forwards /api calls same-origin to the API worker.

nodes.label: Hono app & middleware
nodes.detail: Mounts /api/v1 with request id, CORS and error handling.

nodes.label: Client auth API
nodes.detail: Email one-time code request/verify, sessions, sign-out and account patch.

nodes.label: Clients & shifts API
nodes.detail: Profile sync, shift request, cancel, rate, report and care notes.

nodes.label: Service requests API
nodes.detail: Telehealth, prescription, transport and other service requests with idempotency.

nodes.label: Caregiver API
nodes.detail: Caregiver availability, assigned shifts, clock-in and clock-out.

nodes.label: Assistant API
nodes.detail: Rate-limited chat endpoint with a safety guard and emergency detection.

nodes.label: Storage API
nodes.detail: Signed upload URLs and owner-checked file reads.

nodes.label: Admin auth API
nodes.detail: Staff login, MFA, enrolment, invitation and logout endpoints.

nodes.label: Admin operations API
nodes.detail: Municipality-scoped overview, request, shift, client, provider and payment views and CSV exports.

nodes.label: Admin actions API
nodes.detail: Assign caregiver, cancel, complete and record payout on requests.

nodes.label: Admin accounts API
nodes.detail: SUPER_ADMIN account, invitation, unlock and session management.

nodes.label: Staff security
nodes.detail: PBKDF2 passwords, TOTP, encrypted secrets, sessions, scope rules.

nodes.label: Assistant logic
nodes.detail: Prompt, knowledge base, guard and Gemini calls with a fallback model.

nodes.label: Mailer & notify
nodes.detail: SMTP client over cloudflare:sockets for sign-in codes and family notices.

nodes.label: Audit log
nodes.detail: Records every staff write and sensitive read.

nodes.label: Neon Postgres
nodes.detail: Drizzle schema: users, profiles, shifts, service requests, payments, staff, sessions, audit logs.

nodes.label: R2 uploads bucket
nodes.detail: Object storage for uploaded files (prescriptions and similar).

nodes.label: Google Gemini
nodes.detail: LLM behind the Care Assistant.

nodes.label: Gmail SMTP
nodes.detail: Delivers sign-in codes and family notices.

nodes.label: Cloudflare Workers
nodes.detail: Hosts the API (Hyperdrive, rate limiters) and the Pages sites.

flows.name: Family signs in and requests care
